description: Sprint-22 sharded-harvest per-case verdict extracts (compact). One JSON object per line, sorted by id. Full audit trail (prompts, responses, candidate snapshots, journals) lives on the eval machine under /var/tmp/capybase-live/s22/flights-shard*/ and is not committed.

schema.dataset: upstream project the conflict was mined from
schema.terminal_reason: why a non-PASS run stopped (REPAIR_FAILURE, TIMEOUT_CONVERGENCE, SAFE_STOP, SAFE_SKIP, ...)
schema.matches_oracle: token similarity to the human resolution
schema.escalated: the session aborted back to the pre-rebase HEAD

corpus: 677 real-world rebase conflicts mined from upstream histories; each case carries both sides, the merge base, and the actual human resolution as oracle
endpoint: local OpenAI-compatible endpoint via provider config 'nova-gemma4' (host not tracked; see docs/PROVIDER_CONFIG.md)
command_template: scripts/longrun.sh s22-shard<N>-<lang> env CAPYBASE_SKIP_SIZE_GUARD=1 .venv/bin/python scripts/live_eval_realworld.py --provider nova-gemma4 --lang <lang> --repeat-nonpass 3 --skip-existing --out <results>.json --preserve-flights <flights-dir> (CAPYBASE_SKIP_SIZE_GUARD=1 is REQUIRED: without it the loader silently drops >48K-marker cases — 87 of 167 cpp — and the run exits 0 as an incomplete subset; the harness now prints a SUBSET RUN banner)

shard1-python.jsonl.state: sprint-21 stack + pre-eval items 1&2 (unused-function deletion, string-literal repair)

shard2-c.jsonl.state: + P1 SAFE_SKIP classification, P2 adaptive retry relaxation

shard3-rust.jsonl.state: + P3 extreme-asymmetry fast path, P4 insertion-within-deletion salvage

shard4-cpp.jsonl.state: same as shard 3 (only docs commits since)
shard4-cpp.jsonl.ran: first launch 2026-08-23 10:53 WITHOUT the size-guard env -> 80/167 subset (exit 0, looked complete; incident in PLAN-LEDGER-S22.md); relaunched 12:52 with the gate, identical cmd to shards 1-3 modulo --lang cpp (verified against longrun cmd files), --skip-existing ran the missing 87

baseline.what: sprint-20 full-corpus harvest (677 cases, single mechanism state), the delta reference for every PASS% comparison

verification: see README 'Results' section; every number in the table recomputes from these extracts with the commands given there
no_midrun_contamination: each mechanism change landed in a between-shards gap; verified by mechanism-signature absence in flight journals (P4 signature absent from all shard-2 flights)
